subtitles.beyondthelimits.noclip_whoosh: You fall out of the world
book.beyondthelimits.title: The Surveyor's Guide
book.beyondthelimits.welcome.title: WELCOME
book.beyondthelimits.welcome.body: If you are reading this, the world has already started to come apart, and you were handed a book about it.
book.beyondthelimits.the_bleeding.title: THE BLEEDING
book.beyondthelimits.the_bleeding.body: It began as a hairline. A place where the air did not agree with itself. The survey that preceded yours recorded three such places in the first month, and eleven in the second, and then stopped recording them, because there was no longer a useful distinction between a tear and the sky.
book.beyondthelimits.reality.title: REALITY
book.beyondthelimits.reality.body: The number in the margin is not a score. It is the proportion of this world that still follows the rules it was built on. It falls for reasons, and it falls faster when you are not watching.
book.beyondthelimits.rifts.title: RIFTS
book.beyondthelimits.rifts.body: A rift is not a door and it is not a block. It is a place where two worlds are close enough to touch, and it will drag light, sound and matter through in that order.
book.beyondthelimits.the_city.title: THE CITY
book.beyondthelimits.the_city.body: There is a city. It is not in the world's history and it is not in its future; it is simply standing there, built by something that surveyed before you did. The guide contains its coordinates once you have seen enough to be trusted with them.
book.beyondthelimits.the_warehouse.title: THE WAREHOUSE
book.beyondthelimits.the_warehouse.body: At the centre of the city: a warehouse. Inside it, a rift that does not lead somewhere else so much as it leads somewhere under. Do not go through it without a reason. Go through it once, at least.
book.beyondthelimits.the_backrooms.title: THE BACKROOMS
book.beyondthelimits.the_backrooms.body: Yellow wallpaper. Damp carpet. A ceiling of fluorescent panels that hum a note you will hear for the rest of your life. The rooms go on and the rooms change and there is no exit, only further in.
book.beyondthelimits.other_worlds.title: OTHER WORLDS
book.beyondthelimits.other_worlds.body: The fog is a dimension. The code is a dimension. Your reflection has a dimension, and it has been there long enough to have built things. Everything the world is losing, it is losing to somewhere.
book.beyondthelimits.rules.title: RULES
book.beyondthelimits.rules.body: You may stabilise a rift with the right instrument. You may not close the sky. You may leave a world and come back to a different one, and the difference is your fault, and the ledger does not care which of those two facts you find harder.
rift.beyondthelimits.variant.4: somewhere that is your world, reversed
message.beyondthelimits.intro.one: Something in the world has been revised. You may not notice for a while.
message.beyondthelimits.intro.two: You have been given a journal. It belonged to a surveyor who is no longer surveying.
message.beyondthelimits.guide.given: The Surveyor's Guide is yours now. Press G to read it.
message.beyondthelimits.guide.again: The journal opens where you left it.
message.beyondthelimits.rift.opened: A rift has opened nearby. Reality is holding at %s%%.
message.beyondthelimits.rift.touched: You touched it, and it touched back.
message.beyondthelimits.observer.seven: Whatever is watching you has been doing so for a week.
message.beyondthelimits.observer.base: It is standing in your base. It has been for some time.
message.beyondthelimits.returned: You came back. %s did not come back with you, entirely.
message.beyondthelimits.collision.deeper: Another world is %s%% of the way through this one.
message.beyondthelimits.blacksun.arrival: It arrived. It has been arriving for days.
message.beyondthelimits.blacksun.close: It is closer than it was. It is always closer than it was.
message.beyondthelimits.blacksun.taken: The light is gone. Something else is in the sky now.
message.beyondthelimits.storm.begin: A dimensional storm is forming. Find cover, or find something to hold onto.
message.beyondthelimits.storm.end: The storm has passed. The ground is not where it left it.
message.beyondthelimits.storm.stamp: The storm wrote something permanent into the terrain.
message.beyondthelimits.backrooms.welcom: You are not where you were. The carpet is damp and there are no windows.
message.beyondthelimits.backrooms.fall: You fell through the floor and kept falling.
message.beyondthelimits.backrooms.hum: The lights are humming a note you will not forget.
message.beyondthelimits.backrooms.escape: You found a way out. Statistically, you should not have.
message.beyondthelimits.codescape.welcom: The terrain here is not terrain. You are standing on the source of the world.
message.beyondthelimits.codescape.monoli: net.minecraft.world.chunk.WorldChunk — 98,304 blocks per instance, allocated whether or not you ever visit them.
net.minecraft.entity.Entity.tick() — called for every loaded entity. It has never once checked whether anyone was watching.
net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.tickWorlds() — twenty times a second, for as long as the world exists. You are inside this call right now.
net.minecraft.world.World.setBlockState(BlockPos, BlockState, int) — every change you have made passes through this method, including the ones you made before you noticed.
net.minecraft.client.render.WorldRenderer.renderSky(...) — the sky is a gradient and a texture, redrawn each frame. It has never been anywhere.
net.minecraft.util.math.random.Random — seeded, deterministic, reproducible. Nothing it produces is unexpected, and everything you have seen tonight was decided before you arrived.
the file this came from is not on your disk. it is the program you are standing in.
message.beyondthelimits.mirror.entered: You stepped through, and your reflection stepped out.
message.beyondthelimits.mirror.reflectio: Something is copying the things you build.
message.beyondthelimits.mirror.swapped: You have been replaced. The replacement is doing better than you were.
message.beyondthelimits.signal.realisati: The signal has been coming from your own position for some time.
message.beyondthelimits.city.built: You have found the city. It is at %s.
message.beyondthelimits.lostciv.built: The civilization that was not there has rebuilt itself to stage %s.
message.beyondthelimits.movingchunk.trai: A piece of the world moved past you, heading for %s.
message.beyondthelimits.movingchunk.unkn: Something is running, and it is carrying its own ground.
message.beyondthelimits.evolution.learne: The mobs have learned something about you.
message.beyondthelimits.impossible.found: This biome should not exist. It has decided that it does.
message.beyondthelimits.impossible.notic: The biome is reacting to how you behave in it.
message.beyondthelimits.gravity.debt: Dimensional gravity: %s of %s. The world is keeping score.
message.beyondthelimits.gravity.left: You have left the Overworld for %s. It will remember.
message.beyondthelimits.gravity.returned: You have been away too long. %s things happened while you were in %s, and all of them are your fault.
message.beyondthelimits.lastchunk.found: You found it. The chunk is a perfect reconstruction of everywhere you have ever been, and it is still being built.
command.beyondthelimits.backrooms: The gate is open. Do not lose the way back.
command.beyondthelimits.storm: A storm of intensity %s is running for %s ticks.
command.beyondthelimits.guide: The journal has been returned to you.
command.beyondthelimits.failed: That did not work. Reality refused.
dementia.beyondthelimits.hearing: You are hearing things that are not there. Some of them are.
dementia.beyondthelimits.leaving: You are leaving part of yourself in this dimension.
dementia.beyondthelimits.falling: You are falling through something that used to be ground.
item.beyondthelimits.memory_shard.empty: The shard is empty. Fill it with something worth remembering.
item.beyondthelimits.memory_shard.stored: The shard contains a memory of %s blocks.
item.beyondthelimits.reality_warhead.arm: Armed. This will not make things better.
item.beyondthelimits.rift_stabilizer.non: There is nothing here to close.
item.beyondthelimits.signal_receiver.sil: Silence. The transmission is not on this frequency yet.
item.beyondthelimits.storm_beacon.starte: The beacon has called something down.
item.beyondthelimits.storm_beacon.active: A storm is already running. Adding to it is not wisdom.
item.beyondthelimits.void_lens.revealed: The lens shows you %s things you were not meant to see.
lore.beyondthelimits.guide.warehouse: At its centre is a warehouse. Inside the warehouse is a rift that is not a rift.
lore.beyondthelimits.guide.warning: Do not go through it twice in one day.
lore.beyondthelimits.guide.blacksun: The sun is being replaced. Do not look at it directly, and do not look away.
lore.beyondthelimits.guide.signal: A transmission has been repeating since before you arrived.
lore.beyondthelimits.objectives.civiliza: The civilization that was not there: stage %s.
lore.beyondthelimits.tablet.reward: The tablet accepts what you have learned. Something is given back.
lore.beyondthelimits.statue.0: The statue's face has been worn away by a weather that never happened here.
lore.beyondthelimits.statue.1: The inscription is in a script that is almost readable, in the way a familiar word is almost the right word.
lore.beyondthelimits.statue.2: It is holding a tool. You have the same tool in your inventory. It is carved holding it the same way you hold it.
lore.beyondthelimits.statue.3: Someone has already surveyed this. The survey is the statue.
lore.beyondthelimits.statue.4: There is a name on the plinth. It is not yours. It is not anyone's, yet.
lore.beyondthelimits.statue.5: You have seen this statue before, at a different site, in a different shape, in the same pose.
lore.beyondthelimits.tablet.0: The tablet is warm. The first line is a date, and the date is next week.
lore.beyondthelimits.tablet.1: The second line describes a structure you have not built yet, in the past tense.
lore.beyondthelimits.tablet.2: The third line names the person who will read it. You are getting closer to being that person.
lore.beyondthelimits.tablet.3: The fourth line is a map, and the map is of a place that is being built while you read.
lore.beyondthelimits.tablet.4: The fifth line is an apology.
lore.beyondthelimits.tablet.5: The sixth line is blank, and the blank is addressed to you.
